subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB2466
title: Allows a law enforcement agency or public body to provide information, or enter into an agreement to provide information, as required to effect an international extradition and return of a person charged with or convicted of a crime in this state and for whom a warrant of arrest has been issued.
headline: HB 2466 did not pass

claims.text: HB 2466 was introduced in the House on January 13, 2025.
HB 2466 was still in a House committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
